summary: We collectively have 4 iron ingots and 1 redstone; Jill has crafting table access and knows the compass recipe. I (Andy) have some meta blocked actions, Jill has none, and we both share the goal to craft a compass.
Andy gives Jill 2 iron ingots; Jill, who has redstone, crafting-table access, and the recipe knowledge, crafts the compass.
